problem: Given that ${i,j}$ is the standard basis of ${R}^{2}$ and that the images of $i$ and $j$ under the action of a linear transformation $T$ are $⟨1,4⟩$ and $⟨5,-1⟩$, respectively, what is the standard matrix of $T?$
worked_solution:
Every linear transformation in ${R}^{2}$ can be represented as a $2\times 2$ matrix. The standard matrix representation of the transformation has columns that are the images of the vectors $i$ and $j$ under the action of the transformation.

Therefore, the standard matrix for this linear transformation is 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 4 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$
